title: fix(google): map more Gemini finish reasons and report tool_use

files.patch:
@@ -20,6 +20,7 @@ and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0
 
 ### Bug fixes
 
+* `ChatGoogle()` now reports `finish_reason == "content_filter"` for Gemini's `IMAGE_SAFETY`, `IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT`, `IMAGE_RECITATION` and `LANGUAGE` finish reasons, instead of passing the raw Gemini string through, and reports `"tool_use"` (rather than `"success"`) when a turn ends with a tool request, as `ChatOpenAI()` does. (#473)
 * The error raised for a tool request with invalid JSON arguments from `ChatOpenAI()` and `ChatOpenAICompletions()` (and the providers built on them) now shows the offending arguments, instead of the literal text `{args}`.
 * `content_image_url()` with a `data:` URL no longer silently drops the `detail` argument: the setting is now carried by inline image content and forwarded to OpenAI's Responses and Chat Completions APIs (regular image URLs already forwarded it). Other providers continue to ignore `detail`. (#467)
 * `ChatBedrockAnthropic()` now uses native structured outputs for `data_model` on Claude 4.5 and later, as `ChatAnthropic()` does. Its Bedrock model IDs (`anthropic.claude-...`, `us.anthropic.claude-...`) weren't recognized, so it fell back to forcing a tool call, which Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 reject with a 400.

     assert google_normalize_finish_reason("SPII") == "content_filter"
 
 
+def test_normalize_finish_reason_maps_image_and_language_filters():
+    assert google_normalize_finish_reason("IMAGE_SAFETY") == "content_filter"
+    assert (
+        google_normalize_finish_reason("IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT") == "content_filter"
+    )
+    assert google_normalize_finish_reason("IMAGE_RECITATION") == "content_filter"
+    assert google_normalize_finish_reason("LANGUAGE") == "content_filter"
+
+
+def _function_call_response(finish_reason):
+    from google.genai.types import (
+        Candidate,
+        FunctionCall,
+        GenerateContentResponse,
+        Part,
+    )
+    from google.genai.types import (
+        Content as GoogleContent,
+    )
+
+    return GenerateContentResponse(
+        candidates=[
+            Candidate(
+                content=GoogleContent(
+                    parts=[Part(function_call=FunctionCall(name="get_time", args={}))],
+                    role="model",
+                ),
+                finish_reason=finish_reason,
+                index=0,
+            )
+        ]
+    )
+
+
+def test_google_value_turn_tool_request_finishes_as_tool_use():
+    provider = GoogleProvider(
+        model="gemini-2.5-flash", api_key="dummy", name="Google/Gemini", kwargs=None
+    )
+    completion = _function_call_response(GoogleFinishReason.STOP)
+
+    turn = provider.value_turn(completion, has_data_model=False)
+
+    assert any(isinstance(c, ContentToolRequest) for c in turn.contents)
+    assert turn.finish_reason == "tool_use"
+
+
+def test_google_stream_turn_tool_request_finishes_as_tool_use():
+    provider = GoogleProvider(
+        model="gemini-2.5-flash", api_key="dummy", name="Google/Gemini", kwargs=None
+    )
+    completion = provider.stream_merge_chunks(
+        None, _function_call_response(GoogleFinishReason.STOP)
+    )
+
+    turn = provider.stream_turn(completion, has_data_model=False)
+
+    assert turn.finish_reason == "tool_use"
+
+
 def test_normalize_finish_reason_passes_through_unknown():
     assert google_normalize_finish_reason("OTHER") == "OTHER"
     assert google_normalize_finish_reason("NEW_REASON") == "NEW_REASON"
